summary: #smallpoems the stolen glances and incessant sounds of Maelzel’s stolen curse no longer provide shelter Order lost Selective tones seek escape of rhythm and rhyme an Object to Be Destroyed reconfigured in time back and back again,
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
the stolen glances
and incessant sounds of
Maelzel’s stolen curse
no longer provide shelter
Order lost
Selective tones seek escape
of rhythm
and rhyme
an Object to Be Destroyed
reconfigured in time
back
and back again,
